sources.btcPrice: Coinbase Exchange candles (BTC-USD), gaps filled from Yahoo Finance
sources.sma200: Computed 200-day simple moving average of BTC close
sources.fundingRate: HTX BTC-USDT perpetual historical funding rate; daily average of 8h rates (% )
sources.etfFlows: The Block Spot Bitcoin ETF Flows (sum of US spot BTC ETFs)

notes: 2026 values are year-to-date through the latest available date.
Spot BTC ETFs start in January 2024; 2023 ETF flow is null.
Positive exchange netflow = net BTC onto exchanges (often sell pressure).
Funding > 0 = longs pay shorts; < 0 = shorts pay longs.
